This is a '''list of staff members''' who worked on the [[Generation VIII|eighth generation]] games [[Pokémon Sword and Shield]] for the [[Nintendo Switch]], per the game's [[credits]]. This includes staff added in Versions 1.2.0 and Version 1.3.0 as part of [[The Isle of Armor]] and [[The Crown Tundra]] expansions, respectively. It was published by [[Nintendo]] and developed by [[Game Freak]].
